claim: EFS replication is not point-in-time consistent: changes are transferred based on the Last synced time for the replication, and changes made to the source file system after the recorded time might not have been replicated yet.

evidence.quote: Changes made to the source file system are not transferred to the destination file system in a point-in-time consistent manner.
No. EFS Replication doesn't provide point-in-time consistent replication.
Instead they're transferred based on the Last synced time for the replication.
Changes to your source file system after the recorded time might not have be replicated over.
